mapper.sql: select c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_code, c.contact_person, c.contact_phone, c.contact_email, c.address, c.credit_limit, c.credit_used, c.payment_terms, c.customer_level, c.shop_dept_id, shop_dept.dept_name as shop_dept_name, c.status, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark from inv_customer c left join sys_dept shop_dept on shop_dept.dept_id = c.shop_dept_id
